name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
summary: Beneath Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, a Scarlet Zealot is held captive. Forsaken apothecaries use him to test concoctions for the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: A Bitter Captive in Brill
sections.body: Beneath Gallows' End Tavern, a Scarlet Crusade zealot remains chained and defiant. His unyielding faith reflects his order, and he sees the undead around him as abominations. He calls on the Light to shield him from the foul creatures holding him. The Forsaken did not capture him out of mercy. As a living human, he is valuable test material for Apothecary Johaan, who uses him to measure the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development.

faq.q: Why is a Scarlet Zealot kept alive in Brill?
aliases: who is the zealot in brill cellar
faq.answer: The Forsaken keep him captive beneath Gallows' End Tavern as a living human test subject for poisons and chemical agents the Royal Apothecary Society is developing.

faq.q: Where can I find this captive?
faq.answer: He is held in the cellar beneath Gallows' End Tavern, in the center of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: How does he react to the Forsaken around him?
faq.answer: He remains fanatically defiant in captivity, calling on the Light to protect him from his undead captors and swearing the Scarlet Crusade will rid Azeroth of them.

angles.text: To Brill's Forsaken, this chained fanatic represents the crusaders who seek their extermination. They put him to use as test material for an apothecary.
Scarlet zealots claim the Holy Light for their own, but this prisoner's unwavering faith offers no defense against Forsaken captivity.
